bio: A meal in this elegant colonial-style villa is a must for any self-respecting food aficionado. A superb riverside terrace by the Lys, a bustling vibe and old-fashioned table service set the scene at Patyntje, without forgetting the extensive menu of Belgian brasserie favourites. Timeless classics such as eels in sorrel, vol-au-vent and carbonade flamande (stew) prepared with textbook skill and care. Don’t miss the sweetbread fritters – one of the Michelin inspectors’ favourites since time immemorial…...
